newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY O/N RATES DROP TO 24.00 PCT, TRADE HECTIC.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY O/N RATES DROP TO 24.00 PCT, TRADE HECTIC.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interbank rates closed down at 24.00 percent in hectic trade on Thursday and dealers said the rate could slip a bit further tomorrow.
"It was hectic...and there were a lot of demands for prices," said Balazs Varga of Inter-Europa Bank. "Tomorrow the interbank rate should be even lower than today."
The rate was down slightly from Wednesday's close of 24.375 percent.
Traders said money appeared to be flowing back into equities, helping to bring down the interbank rates.
